description: 黑兵捉双——兵同时攻击象和后

intro.popup: 💡 捉双：黑方先走，如何两步之后用兵同时攻击象和后？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Fork: Black to move. How can Black use a pawn to attack the bishop and queen at once in two moves?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：先逼象退，再兵推e4捉双！同时攻击d3象和f3后，赢回子力。
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: First drive the bishop back, then play e4 to fork the bishop on d3 and queen on f3, winning material.

moves.popup: 兵推f5！攻击e4象，逼迫象退后。
moves.popup_en: The pawn advances to f5, attacking the bishop on e4 and forcing it to move.

moves.popup: 白象被迫退到d3，为下一步捉双创造条件。
moves.popup_en: The bishop is forced to retreat to d3, setting up the fork on the next move.

moves.popup: 兵推e4！同时攻击d3象和f3后——捉双！
moves.popup_en: The pawn advances to e4, attacking the bishop on d3 and queen on f3 at once. A fork!

moves.popup: 白象吃兵，但后已无法两全。
moves.popup_en: The bishop captures the pawn, but the queen cannot be saved as well.

moves.popup: 黑兵回吃，e4兵继续攻击f3后。
moves.popup_en: The f-pawn recaptures on e4 and continues attacking the queen on f3.
